body: N-11 part B, SERVER HALF is in a pull request (branch task/N-11b-server-merge-duplicate-refs; not merged, not walked, nothing deployed; N-11 is NOT marked built: the phone half is still to do). DONE: at server start, right after the migrations and before any thread, `refmerge.repair` merges the song refs that hold one file (survivor = the ref whose file row was attached first), after its own kept copy of the database, in one transaction that rolls back on any failure and never stops the server; the second run finds nothing. Held and logged at INFO on every start (expected): refs with different source videos (or different ISRC / Deezer id) and pairs that one live playlist holds both of. Everything a person has follows the song (likes, entries, plays, imports, queued work, saved release songs, the saved queue, both feeds); a `ref_merge` table (migration 0011) keeps the old id and its identifying fields, so an old id still works on every route that takes a song id, and a song described again the way the merged one was finds the survivor (refs.find). The files feed gets `merges: [{from, into, seq}]` with `mergesSince` / `mergesCursor` / `mergesMore` (an app that does not send mergesSince gets none); the real response is saved as app/test/fixtures/server/library-files-with-merges.json, written by the server test. PROOF on a COPY of the copy of VM 108's database with the real function: refs 3528 to 3354, duplicates 178 to 5 (the five held pairs), 174 ref_merge rows, entries / likes / plays per person unchanged, 0 dangling references in any column or the queue, 174 of 174 re-descriptions find the survivor, second run does nothing. FOR THE PHONE HALF: fold `from` into `into` as the page says (docs/17 'Songs merged into another'); apply merges in `seq` order; a survivor merged later appears as a later row; the ids in `from` no longer exist on the server. TWO THINGS THE LEAD ASKED FOR THAT DO NOT EXIST: `openapi.json` and a test that it is current (ADR-R41 T5 is 'planned, not built'; docs/17 line 5): not written by hand, not built here; the contract is in docs/17 and the saved fixture. FOR PR #1 (lyrics, held): its `lyrics.ref` foreign key must be taught to refmerge (FOREIGN_KEY_COLUMNS and _merge_pair); a guard test fails until it is, because a merge would otherwise cascade a loser's lyrics away. DEPLOY ORDER stays the advisor's: not to VM 108 before the phone half exists; the backup path is logged at the first start.
